# Sheng Heng Auto Service Centre

> Continental and Asian car workshop at 17, Jalan Hang Lekir 12, Taman Industri Jaya, 81300 Skudai, Johor, Malaysia. Our workshop since 2010. ADAS calibration, ECU repair and coding, car keys, instrument clusters, gearbox overhaul, diagnostics and servicing. WhatsApp 016-335 2124 (Mr. Yaw). Mon-Sat 9:00am-6:00pm, Sunday closed. Pages in English, Bahasa Malaysia (/ms/) and Simplified Chinese (/zh/).

Site: https://autoseo.my/preview/sheng-heng-auto/
Sitemap: https://autoseo.my/preview/sheng-heng-auto/sitemap.xml

## Services
- [Continental car specialist Skudai | Est. 2010](https://autoseo.my/preview/sheng-heng-auto/continental-car-specialist-skudai/): Continental car specialist in Skudai for BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Porsche, VW, MINI and Peugeot servicing and repair. WhatsApp us to book your car in.
- [ADAS calibration Skudai, Johor Bahru | Est. 2010](https://autoseo.my/preview/sheng-heng-auto/adas-calibration-skudai/): ADAS calibration in Skudai, Johor Bahru for camera and radar warnings and after windscreen work. WhatsApp us a photo of the warning to get started.
- [ECU repair Skudai | Taman Industri Jaya](https://autoseo.my/preview/sheng-heng-auto/ecu-repair-programming-skudai/): ECU repair, ECU programming and coding, Mercedes online SCN coding and immobilizer reset in Skudai. WhatsApp us your car model and the problem.
- [Car key programming Skudai | Est. 2010](https://autoseo.my/preview/sheng-heng-auto/car-key-immobilizer-skudai/): Car key programming in Skudai: smart key copy and programming, plus immobilizer reset. WhatsApp us your car model and we will advise you first.
- [Car coding & meter repair, Skudai JB | Est. 2010](https://autoseo.my/preview/sheng-heng-auto/car-coding-instrument-cluster-skudai/): Car coding and meter repair in Skudai, Johor Bahru: cluster change, meter screen repair, retrofits and programming. WhatsApp us your car model.
- [Gearbox overhaul Skudai | Taman Industri Jaya](https://autoseo.my/preview/sheng-heng-auto/gearbox-overhaul-skudai/): Gearbox overhaul in Skudai for Lexus, Hyundai, BMW and CVT cars: transfer case rebuild, bearings and clutch plates. WhatsApp us your car model.
- [Car diagnostic Skudai | Warning lights, Est. 2010](https://autoseo.my/preview/sheng-heng-auto/car-diagnostic-skudai/): Car diagnostic in Skudai: computer scan, warning lights, ABS pump repair and electronic trouble-shooting. WhatsApp us a photo of your dashboard.
- [Car service Skudai | Est. 2010, Taman Industri Jaya](https://autoseo.my/preview/sheng-heng-auto/car-service-skudai/): Car service in Skudai: engine oil, gear oil, brakes, battery, tyre check, shocks and hybrid care. Pay by instalment with AhaPay. WhatsApp us to book.
